description: Rewrite the three example module workflows and manifests to MAF declarative YAML + PowerFx (design sections 9, 16), in the PROBE-C-selected input-shaping form recorded by FEAT-001, remove every demo: block (Demo behavior now lives in DemoResponseProvider from FEAT-003), add manifest terminals[] metadata, and drop the per-workflow schema comment pointing at the deleted workflow.schema.json. Also migrate the test-only fixtures module that covers every step kind. Depends on FEAT-003 (the seam runs these YAMLs end to end). This feature proves behavior parity for jokes/support/_template in Demo mode.
steps: jokes (design section 9.1): rewrite modules/jokes/definition/workflows/joke.yaml to kind: Workflow with trigger OnConversationStart id joke: InvokeAzureAgent 'tell' (agent comedian, structured 'joke' output schema on the action, input UserMessage(System.LastMessage.Text)); SetVariable 'tell_snapshot' writing Global.tell = serialized Local.tell; SendActivity 'done' with {MessageText(Local.tell)}. Remove the demo: block and the # yaml-language-server schema comment. Update modules/jokes/definition/module.yaml workflows[] to the descriptor form (id joke, file, version 1, name, input schema, terminals: done -> success).

support (design sections 9.2, 9.3): rewrite modules/support/definition/workflows/support-email.yaml. Input shaping per PROBE-C: ParseJSON form uses SetVariable read_input Global.in = ParseJSON(System.LastMessage.Text) then Global.in.subject/.body; structured-args form reads Global.subject/.body (only one ships). classify: InvokeAzureAgent (structured classification.schema.json) + SetVariable Global.classify snapshot + ConditionGroup after_classify (Local.classify.isCodeRelated=true -> route_team else classified_out_of_scope). route_team: explicit PowerFx with Lower(subject & ' ' & body) and IsMatch literals ALL lower-cased (application\s?a / application\s?b) with a one-line invariant comment; ConditionGroup rt_branch: both-match -> fail_ambiguous, no-match -> fail_no_app, A -> set Local.route TeamA/ApplicationA/application-a, else TeamB/ApplicationB/application-b; SetVariable Global.route_team snapshot. assign_agent: Switch(Local.classify.category, BackendBug->BackendDeveloper, FrontendBug->FrontendDeveloper, QualityTestIssue->QAEngineer) for role, Local.route.teamName & '_' & role for id; SetVariable Global.assignedAgentId (seam -> RunContext.AssignAgent) and Global.assign_agent snapshot; missing-category -> failure terminal with the current message. locate_component: InvokeMcpTool serverLabel support, toolName support.locateComponent, arguments { applicationFolder: =Local.route.applicationFolder, text: =Local.rtText }, output.result Local.locateRaw, then SetVariable Local.locate = ParseJSON(First(Local.locateRaw).Value) and SetVariable Global.locate_component = First(Local.locateRaw).Value; downstream reads Local.locate.path/.component/.language/.snippet. resolve + generate_code: InvokeAzureAgent structured (resolution.schema.json, pull-request.schema.json) each followed by SetVariable Global.<stepId> snapshot. approval: Question gate (NOT RequestExternalInput) rendering the review title+labeled fields with {expr}; resume carries JSON {decision,reason}; SetVariable Local.approval = ParseJSON(Local.approvalRaw); ConditionGroup (NOT If) on Local.approval.decision='approved' -> generate_code else manual_review_required; SetVariable Global.approval = Local.approvalRaw snapshot. Terminals carry verbatim messages: fail_ambiguous 'Ambiguous routing: both ApplicationA and ApplicationB are mentioned.', fail_no_app 'Cannot determine affected application: neither ApplicationA nor ApplicationB is mentioned.', manual_review_required message Coalesce(Local.approval.reason, "Rejected") (exact capital R), code_change_generated success output = generate_code, classified_out_of_scope success message from classify reasoning. Remove every demo: block and the schema comment.

support manifest: update modules/support/definition/module.yaml workflows[] to the descriptor form (id support-email, file, version 1, name, description, title "{subject}", input schema) with terminals[]: code_change_generated success, classified_out_of_scope success, manual_review_required failure, fail_ambiguous failure, fail_no_app failure, and the missing-category failure terminal. Keep tools[] (support.locateComponent) and samples[] unchanged.

_template (design section 16): rewrite modules/_template/definition/workflows/template-hello.yaml to MAF declarative (one InvokeAzureAgent summarize step + one InvokeMcpTool wordCount step via ModuleToolHandler), remove its demo.output.summary (now DemoResponseProvider keyed (template-hello, summarize)), add Global.<stepId> snapshots, and update modules/_template/definition/module.yaml workflows[] to the descriptor form with terminals[]. _template stays disabled in the AppHost by default (unchanged).

Fixtures module: migrate backend/tests/Fixtures/Flowgent.Fixtures.Module/definition (the test-only module covering every step kind) to MAF declarative so it loads under the new format; update its manifest workflows[]/terminals[] and remove demo: blocks, keeping the same logical coverage the integration tests rely on. If a step kind has moved to DemoResponseProvider, add the corresponding keyed entry or adjust the fixture to the declarative equivalent.

Confirm the modules load and trial-build clean and run end-to-end in Demo mode via the module test suites (these use PlatformHarness + ModuleDefinitionAssert.IsValid). Adjust prompt files only if the rendered-prompt contract DemoResponseProvider depends on (e.g. jokes 'Tell a joke about: <topic>', support 'Subject: ...\n\nBody: ...') requires it; keep prompts otherwise unchanged.

REQUIRED (handed off from FEAT-002, Option A1): re-enable modules/support/tests/SupportDefinitionTests.cs. FEAT-002 wrapped that whole file in `#if false ... #endif` with a `// TODO(FEAT-004)` header because the suite is built on the deleted custom step model (FindStep/RuleStep/MapStep/LlmStep.Demo/RuleMatcher over RuleDefinition) and could not compile against WorkflowDescriptor. Remove the `#if false`/`#endif` and port every preserved assertion to the migrated declarative support YAML + DemoResponseProvider behavior (routing single/both/no-application outcomes, category->role agent mapping, demo classification keyword rules, severity Critical/High/Medium, PR paths under dummyAppsRoot). Do NOT leave the file disabled.
acceptance_criteria: jokes, support, _template, and the fixtures module definitions are MAF declarative YAML with no demo: block anywhere and no reference to the deleted workflow.schema.json.
Each manifest workflows[] uses the descriptor form with terminals[] outcomes matching the old terminal outcomes.

`dotnet test --project modules/support/tests` passes: ModuleDefinitionAssert.IsValid succeeds and the support flow runs end to end in Demo mode (classify->route->assign->locate->resolve->approval->generate->code_change_generated; rejected->manual_review_required with reason; out-of-scope->classified_out_of_scope; ambiguous/no-app verbatim failures).
`dotnet test --project modules/_template/tests` passes on the new format.

modules/support/tests/SupportDefinitionTests.cs is re-enabled (the FEAT-002 `#if false` removed) and its assertions are ported to the declarative model; `dotnet build backend/Flowgent.slnx` compiles that file and the suite is no longer excluded.
findings:
DONE + verified (commit 8874e27 on feature/maf-declarative-engine): jokes, support and _template migrated to MAF declarative YAML + PowerFx; manifests in descriptor form with terminals[]; all demo: blocks + workflow.schema.json comments removed; SupportDefinitionTests re-enabled (FEAT-002 #if false removed) and ported to DemoResponseProvider + the declarative model. Verification: `dotnet test modules/support/tests` 73/73, `dotnet test modules/_template/tests` 9/9, `dotnet build backend/Flowgent.slnx` 0/0.

CHOSEN PROBE FORMS / declarative-syntax findings (also in .kiro/specs/maf-declarative-migration/tasks.md 'FEAT-004 declarative-syntax findings'): PROBE-C ParseJSON absent -> field reads via the executor's own parse First(Local.x).field through two built-in seam MCP tools flowgent.input (echoes run input) and flowgent.parse (echoes an arbitrary payload); IsMatch 'recognized but not supported' -> routing = Lower(subject & ' ' & body) + Find('application a'|'applicationa') (faithful to Application\s?A); InvokeAzureAgent does NOT pass inputs/stepId to the provider -> agent.name carries 'stepId|agentId' (PowerFx expr allowed); GotoAction jumps to the exact action id (target a terminal's first SetVariable, not its SendActivity); EndConversation stops terminal fall-through; Global.<step>__detail must be written BEFORE the snapshot so both are in the same checkpoint; agent calls use non-streaming RunAsync so telemetry records; PowerFx checkpoint values are recursive {typeId,value} envelopes the seam strips; WorkflowProjector line-scans kind/id (PowerFx exprs break YamlDotNet).

SEAM WORK FOLDED IN (approved): built-in input/parse tools (ModuleToolHandler); MafRunDriver surfaces step outputs + __detail in deterministic workflow order, reads terminal id/message/finalOutput from reserved Global.__terminalId/__message/__finalOutput, recursively unwraps PowerFx cells, normalises the Question port id (_Input suffix) to the step id; MafAgentProvider stepId|agentId name convention + non-streaming; RunOrchestrator builds the HITL ReviewPayload from the Question prompt JSON (ReviewFromPrompt); WorkflowProjector snapshot-steps + manifest-terminals via line scan; IntakeService threads manifest workflows[].errorMessage; module.schema.json gained workflows[].errorMessage.

DIAGNOSTIC IDs / terminals: success terminals = code_change_generated, classified_out_of_scope (support), done (jokes/template); failure terminals = manual_review_required, fail_ambiguous, fail_no_app, no_agent_mapping (support). Each terminal writes Global.__terminalId (+ __message, and __finalOutput for success outputs).

THREE DOCUMENTED OBSERVABILITY CONTRACT CHANGES (business outcomes preserved; see FEAT-004-observability-gap-analysis.md Gaps 2/3; SupportParityTests assertions updated with inline references): (1) routing failures are explicit fail_ambiguous/fail_no_app terminals so run.CurrentStepId is the terminal id, not 'route_team'; (2) every step emits StepStarted+StepCompleted in deterministic workflow order (old engine suppressed StepStarted for synchronous rule/map steps); (3) the dashboard graph shows 7 pipeline steps + 6 terminals = 13 nodes (was 10).

DEFERRED TO FEAT-005 (Option B, parent-approved): the test-only fixtures module (backend/tests/Fixtures) and Flowgent.Integration.Tests were NOT migrated here. They are already RED since FEAT-003 (old custom format invalid under the new loader; NOT a FEAT-004 regression) and their porting is FEAT-005 task 2.6. Handoff notes (http-step probe-or-bridge decision, the two fixture integration-test changes, baseline-failure bookkeeping) were added to FEAT-005.json.
